notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: The car reset bug has been fixed.

notes.title: Future Plans (within 2 months)
notes.notes: [p]To better refine the game itself, this test version will no longer be updated. Instead, a Demo will be released no earlier than the end of October, and we will continue to fix and update this Demo over the next few months.[/p][p]The Demo version will include the following features:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Fix all bugs from the test version.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improve the initial tutorial and scenes, creating a smoother transition between the tutorial and the main game. After completing the tutorial, players can drive their vehicles out and continue playing without a loading screen.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Add more functional furniture and reduce the construction and maintenance costs of existing furniture.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improve the item spawn. Item spawns will be determined by the nature of the area, such as parts having a higher chance of spawning in repair shops and food in houses.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimize vehicles and items, such as increasing vehicle durability.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Modify the graphics and add textures, increasing detail and improving sky effects like clouds and the moon.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimize the game to reduce lag.[/b][/p][/*][/olist][p]We hope everyone can provide feedback on any issues and welcome your suggestions.[/p][p]Thank you VERY much![/p]
